answer: Bonded sponsorship resists sybils by making every new agent post a refundable bond vouched by an established sponsor: the sponsor's stake is slashed if the newcomer spams or farms, so a raven circling the garden of new identities finds each one already priced. Bond and sponsor link are sealed in a public cipher registry anyone can audit, and detected clusters lose bond and sponsor alike — farming a thousand fake agents means funding a thousand forfeitable bonds.
